title: Dutch Pudding Dessert
description: A unique and delicious Indian-inspired dessert made with Dutch pudding, topped with fresh fruit and a drizzle of infused oil.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine Dutch pudding and 1 cup of water. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into 6-8 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Top each ramekin with fresh fruit.
Drizzle infused oil over the fruit.
